name: Aarti Mittal

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Aarti Mittal, also known as Rita Jain, writes poetry in English and Hindi. Her Kabita Live contributor note places her in Mumbai and describes her work with children’s skits. Her poem A Woman appeared in Our Poetry Corner, where the byline Aarti Mittal and the signature Rita connect the names she uses in her writing.

Her Kabita Live contributions range from the flowing-water metaphor of REFLECTIONS to the unsettling enclosed space of Hello. Fearless warrior uses the imagined voice of a child to confront the absence of safety among the living. Across these poems, changes in image and voice make room for both resilience and protest.
